subject: Pilot proposal: Efficiency pilot — packaging options & commercial pathways
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia@nimblehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Anh Nguyen <annguyen@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — cost structure and performance guidance

Hi Alex,

Thanks for the demo last week — product looked solid. Our leadership asked for a short pilot to validate (1) token-cost delta using batching/cache, (2) quality delta with int8/ggml quantization, and (3) predictable latency under our peak windows.

Could you outline the commercial options for a 6-week pilot? Specifically: a) a simple credits-only pilot, b) a time-boxed reserved capacity pilot (small dedicated), and c) an advisory + credits combo that includes a short quantization recommendation and runbook.

We also need to understand what kinds of credits/discounts Redwood typically gives for pilots, and whether model variants (smaller quantized vs full fp16) are included in the same credit bucket or billed differently.

If you can send a short SOW and a few pricing paths by next Tue (June 29) that would be great.

Best,
Olivia
Product Lead, NimbleHealth

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — cost structure and performance guidance

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and for the clear asks. Attached is a one-page SOW + an ops checklist. High-level commercial options below; I kept the math conservative so we can tighten it after you share expected qps/seq-lens.

1) Credits-only pilot (6 weeks)
- $15k of usage credits applied to hosted API (covers embeddings + gen).
- Includes one technical kickoff, a two-week ops deep-dive (batching + prefix cache tuning), and weekly syncs.
- No SLA or dedicated capacity; latency best-effort.

2) Reserved mini (4-week reserved + 2-week ramp)
- Small Dedicated pool (1x A100 equivalent) for the 6-week window: $23k flat for the window.
- Includes pre-provisioning, canary policy, and 99.9% uptime target for pilot traffic.
- Credits for overage (if any) at 50% of normal hosted per-token price.

3) Advisory + credits combo
- $8k advisory fee (quant recommendations, evaluation harness, recommended kernel/compilation knobs) + $10k credits.
- Advisory deliverables: quantization risk matrix, test harness config, 1 FTE*week of hands-on tuning from our infra team (Aditya).

Discounts/credits notes:
- For pilots we typically bundle credits with a modest advisory fee rather than blanket % discounts.
- Quantized model variants billed at a slightly lower token rate (we use an equivalence factor for int8/ggml); we can show expected net-dollar per effective-token after recommendations.

Technical callouts (Aditya looped):
- Batching & prefix caching typically yields 20–40% unit-cost reduction depending on prompt reuse.
- Quantization can reduce GPU memory and allow smaller instances (cost savings) but may need calibration for instruction-following tasks.

Next steps: I’ll follow up with a terser spreadsheet that shows estimated cost under three traffic profiles. Can Marissa confirm if NimbleHealth procurement prefers a single PO to cover credits or separate SOW+PO?

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot inquiry — pricing paths (internal)

Quick internal:
- Procurement at SMB buyers usually want credits on a single PO; it shortens cycle. If they want mini-reserved, we require a short-term contract (4 weeks) and revenue capture as 'reserved pilot' SKU.
- For commercial flexibility: offer credits-only + advisory as the primary path. Reserved mini should be priced to cover opportunity cost — 23k seems reasonable.
- Concessions: we can offer a 10% uplift in credits if they commit to a 6–12 month pilot-to-production evaluation within 90 days.

Aditya: can you draft the quant-risk checklist for the SOW? Priyom: I'll prep the PO template and T&Cs.

-M

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot inquiry — quant checklist + sequencing

Marissa / Alex — draft checklist below (I'll attach a formatted version to the SOW):

- Baseline evaluation: 1k labeled prompts from NimbleHealth (privacy-safe subset).
- Candidate quant schemes: int8 (symmetric), int8+KV-cache-aware, and 4-bit experimental.
- Acceptance criteria: <= 3% instr-following degradation (human eval), and latency at p95 <= 450ms for 8-token generations under pilot qps.
- Rollback plan: auto-fallback to fp16 variant on errors, with tracing to identify failing prompts.
- Batching policy: start with a max batch size tuned to 50ms latency budget; enable prefix KV cache for session reuse (we expect 15–25% token savings).
- Metrics to report nightly: token consumption (per-model), effective tokens (after equivalence), p50/p95 latency, and top-10 prompts with regressions.

I'll include suggested test commands and the Docker test harness. Alex — I recommend the advisory + credits path as the lowest friction for both sides.

- Aditya

From: Olivia Park <olivia@nimblehealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anh Nguyen <annguyen@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot proposal: Efficiency pilot — packaging options & commercial pathways

Alex / Marissa — thank you. We reviewed the SOW and like the advisory + credits option. A few clarifications before we sign:

1) Can the $10k credits be used against both hosted and reserved variants if we need to burst?
2) For the quant equivalence factor: can you send an example calc for how int8 maps to effective tokens (we want to model spend in our forecast)?
3) Can you add a clause that provides a one-time 15% onboarding credit if we convert to a 6-month committed plan within 60 days of pilot close?

If you can send a redline-enabled SOW and a simple spreadsheet with the equivalence calc, we can get procurement to review.

Best —
Olivia
